  7. Screen or Room Divider: To create separation from the rest of the room.
  8. Incense Holder or Candle Stand: To add ambiance, complementing personal style.
  9. Rug: To define the meditation area, with a calming color scheme and soft texture.
  10. Artwork or Decor: Calming elements like a Buddha statue or nature-inspired prints.
